theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_fd_series
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), ∑' i, (X i).mass < ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun i => X i ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' i, (X i).mass ∧ Y.support ⊆ closure (⋃ i, (X i).support) ∧ ((∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X i)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
